llm_response.reason: Independent reports on Reddit, YouTube, and TikTok clearly identify this site as a scam, citing non-delivery of goods and misleading, too-good-to-be-true deals. The website spoofs a legitimate shoe brand (Floris van Bommel) under a mismatched domain name with no public record of official affiliation, and uses urgency and 'safe shopping' claims to manipulate psychological trust. These symptoms match many characteristics of scam websites, especially #1 (low prices), #3 (emotional/psychological manipulation), #4 (unclear or fake company info), #5 (unusual product assortment/branding), and #16 (brand spoofing).
